Streaming chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) yielding multiple SSE chunks

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 32, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Count to three, one word per response.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022', stream: true)).to_a
puts result.chunks.inspect
puts result.stream_content.inspect
puts result.stream_complete.inspect
```
